exit_criteria: Inventory authoritative counter-placement mutations and route one coherent generic family through a typed replaceable event before commit.
Apply replacement-created counter intents, including represented zone-change counters, through the same counter-placement boundary.
Suspend affected-object choices through principal-scoped packets and preserve exact replay without exposing authoritative event payloads.
Promote only source-pinned rules whose positive, negative, interaction, multiplayer where applicable, replay, and implementation-mutation witnesses pass.
Run complete pinned Oracle and Commander-legal card censuses and report exact deltas.
Preserve Game Record v3, principal projection, zero suppressed meaningful windows, and fail-closed unsupported counter semantics.
selected_batch.rationale: The replayable replacement event tree now establishes containing-event order and represented token/zone choices. The next dependency-ready boundary is authoritative counter placement, including replacement-created counter events and affected-object ordering, without claiming universal CR 614/616 producer coverage.

not every replacement or prevention operation that creates tokens or counters lowers to a typed nested event
a typed prohibition event and generic can't-effect registry do not exist
can't-effect creation moments are not tracked relative to proposed events
cost grammar does not generically consult typed can't-events before advertising or paying every event cost
prohibited events are not represented, so the self-replacement-only exception cannot be evaluated
entry can't-effects are not derived through the full would-exist battlefield evaluator
external continuous effects and replacement-modified entry characteristics are incomplete
active static and generated prevention effects are not generically registered from Oracle semantics
engine damage producers are not yet routed through the typed replacement/prevention registry
complete CR 609.7 source selection and last-known source-property evaluation are not implemented
generated prevention effects do not yet have authoritative duration, expiration, and used-up shield state
casting and activation paths do not generically register generated prevention effects
the active-effect registry does not yet record creation moments relative to proposed damage events
additional effects are represented only as payload operations, not queued engine events with immediately-after timing
additional-effect target, trigger, and nested replacement interactions are not integrated
remaining shield amounts are not persisted and consumed across separate damage events
allocation across simultaneous applicable sources is not collected from the affected player
next-instance source shields have no persistent used-up state across events
complete source identity and last-known source handling are not implemented
chosen-source shield creation and cross-event state are not represented
source properties are not generically derived or rechecked through CR 609.7b
one independent prevention shield per untargeted applicable creature is not created or persisted
persistent prevention shields are not represented, so nonconsumption of a shield amount cannot be enforced across later damage events
engine damage producers do not yet preserve the unpreventable marker through the full CR 120.4 pipeline
prevention-application events are not dispatched into the triggered-ability pipeline
simultaneous damage-event grouping for exactly one trigger per prevention application is not represented
generic engine choice packets are wired only into represented token-creation, semantic zone-change, and effect-generated permanent-counter producers
multiple simultaneous events affecting the same chooser do not yet expose an explicit event-order choice when that order could matter
